name: Columbia Gas Transmission Line 1278 Replacement Project
researcher_notes: A Federal Register notice from April 22, 2005 (FERC docket CP04-34 EA for Line 1278) says Columbia would abandon 43.4 miles of 14-inch Line 1278 and replace it with 20-inch pipe in Northampton, Monroe and Pike counties, Pennsylvania, mostly in the existing right-of-way, in two phases in 2005 and 2006, to replace deteriorated sections under a US Department of Transportation mandate. No volume increase. The north end is Columbia's Weber Road Lot in Pike County. Both refs are the same notice (govinfo and federalregister.gov copies), so not independent. No existing GEM row covers Line 1278; P0169 is the system row and P4448 is a different replacement. Passes the 25 km rule (43.4 mi of new pipe). Status not set: no source found confirming completion in 2006 (search was unavailable), so a researcher should confirm in-service status before adding; likely operating. Capacity not stated. Start/end county names are from the notice; exact endpoints and route not found. Parent is TC Energy / Global Infrastructure Partners per the P0169 row; not re-verified. Owner spelling taken from the P0169 row.
